title: Transition to Digital UK eVisa: Phasing out BRPs for Pakistani Applicants
excerpt: UKVI is actively replacing physical Biometric Residence Permits (BRPs) and vignette sticker stamps with digital eVisas. Pakistani passport holders with valid UK leave must link their passports to a UKVI account before international travel.
content:
The UK Visas and Immigration (UKVI) department is completing its transition to a fully digital immigration system. Physical immigration documents, including Biometric Residence Permits (BRPs), Biometric Residence Cards (BRCs), and passport vignette endorsement stickers, are being phased out in favour of digital eVisas.

Key Guidelines for Pakistani Applicants & Residents:
1. Creating your UKVI Account: Individuals residing in the UK or holding valid indefinite or temporary leave must create a UKVI account via gov.uk/evisa to access their digital status.
2. Linking Pakistani Passport: Ensure your current Pakistani passport number and details are strictly identical in your UKVI account. If you renew your passport in Pakistan or at the High Commission in London, immediately update the details online via the 'Update your UK Visas and Immigration account details' service.
3. Travel Verification: Airlines boarding passengers in Islamabad, Karachi, and Lahore will digitally verify visa status before boarding. Carry your expired BRP alongside your valid passport during the transition period as an additional safeguard.
4. Share Codes: Landlords and employers in the UK will now only accept online share codes generated from your UKVI portal for right-to-rent and right-to-work checks.

title: Student Route (CAS) Financial Maintenance & Pakistani Bank Account Rules
excerpt: Home Office enforces updated maintenance fund levels for Pakistani students. Bank statements must strictly demonstrate funds held uninterrupted for 28 consecutive days prior to application submission.
content:
Applying for a UK Student visa from Pakistan requires strict financial compliance under Appendix Student of the UK Immigration Rules.

Critical Checklist for Autumn/Winter Intake:
1. Maintenance Amounts: Students intending to study in Inner London must demonstrate £1,483 per month (up to 9 months, £13,347 maximum). For institutions outside London, the requirement is £1,136 per month (up to 9 months, £10,224 maximum) plus any remaining tuition fee balance.
2. The 28-Day Holding Rule: Funds must be held in an acceptable financial institution in Pakistan for a minimum continuous 28-day period. The closing date of the statement must be within 31 days of the visa application fee payment.
3. Acceptable SBP-Regulated Banks: Accounts must be with banks regulated by the State Bank of Pakistan (SBP) where electronic verification can be performed by the British High Commission. Third-party sponsorship is restricted to official government sponsors or parents/legal guardians with attested birth certificates and consent affidavits.
4. Credibility Interviews: Expect potential UKVI credibility interviews regarding course choice, academic progression, and post-study career trajectory.

title: Gerry's VFS Visa Application Centres: Priority & Prime-Time Appointments in Pakistan
excerpt: Gerry's VFS centres in Islamabad, Lahore, Karachi, and Mirpur announce revised appointment allocation schedules, VIP Premium Lounge enhancements, and biometrics collection procedures.
content:
Visa applicants across Pakistan booking biometrics through the Gerry's Visa Application Centres (VAC) in Islamabad, Lahore, Karachi, and Mirpur should take note of updated operational protocols.

Important Centre Information:
1. Prime Time & Priority Slots: Priority Visa service (5-working-day target decision) and Super Priority Visa (next working day where eligible) appointment slots are released every weekday morning at 08:30 AM PKT on the VFS portal.
2. Document Scanning & Submission: Applicants are strongly advised to upload all supporting documents electronically at least 24 hours prior to their biometrics appointment. On-site document scanning services at Gerry's incur additional fee surcharges.
3. Original Passports & CNIC: Ensure your original valid Pakistani passport, previous expired passports with travel history, and original CNIC/Smart Card are brought to the centre.
4. Mirpur & Quetta Advisory: Demand at the Mirpur Azad Kashmir and Islamabad centres remains at peak capacity. Please schedule appointments at least 3 weeks before your intended travel date.

title: Skilled Worker Route: Minimum Salary Thresholds & Certificate of Sponsorship (CoS)
excerpt: Detailed overview of the general £38,700 salary threshold for new Skilled Worker applications, the Immigration Salary List (ISL), and sponsor licence verification for Pakistani professionals.
content:
Pakistani professionals pursuing career opportunities in the UK under the Skilled Worker visa route must satisfy stringent Home Office requirements following the reform of economic migration.

Key Requirements for Pakistani Applicants:
1. Defined Certificate of Sponsorship (DCoS): Overseas applicants outside the UK require an approved Defined CoS from a Home Office licensed A-rated sponsor. Ensure the sponsor's business activity is legitimate and compliant.
2. General Salary Floor: The baseline general salary threshold is £38,700 per annum or the standard 'going rate' for the specific Standard Occupational Classification (SOC) code, whichever is higher.
3. Health & Care and Immigration Salary List (ISL): Eligible health and social care workers, as well as roles listed on the Immigration Salary List, benefit from lower salary thresholds, though restrictions on bringing family dependents continue to apply for care workers.
4. English Language Proficiency: Proof of B1 level CEFR English proficiency through an approved SELT centre (IELTS for UKVI, PTE Academic UKVI) or a verified ECCTIS qualification recognition letter.

title: UK Spouse & Partner Settlement: Income Thresholds & Appendix FM Guidance
excerpt: Navigating the minimum income requirement, genuine relationship evidence (Nikahnama and NADRA registration), and accommodation checks for Pakistani spouses joining partners in the UK.
content:
Spousal and partner settlement applications under Appendix FM represent one of the most thoroughly audited visa categories for Pakistani applicants.

Crucial Evidence Requirements:
1. Minimum Income Requirement (MIR): The sponsoring partner in the UK must meet the required financial threshold through salaried employment (Category A or B), self-employment (Category F or G), or cash savings held for a minimum of 6 months.
2. Genuine & Subsisting Relationship: Submitting only a NADRA Marriage Registration Certificate (MRC) and Urdu Nikahnama is not sufficient. You must provide comprehensive communication logs, wedding photographs, joint travel documentation, and financial remittances evidencing an active marital relationship.
3. English Language Test A1: The applicant in Pakistan must pass an approved UKVI CEFR A1 Speaking and Listening test (or higher) from a licensed test centre in Islamabad, Lahore, or Karachi.
4. UK Accommodation Audit: An independent property inspection report confirming the UK property is not overcrowded and complies with Public Health Acts.

title: Approved SELT English Test Providers & Tuberculosis (TB) Screening in Pakistan
excerpt: List of authorized IOM medical clinics for mandatory TB clearance certificates and approved Secure English Language Test (SELT) centres across Pakistan.
content:
All Pakistani residents applying to visit the UK for more than 6 months (such as Work, Study, or Settlement visas) must obtain medical clearance and certified English test credentials.

Mandatory Testing Details:
1. Tuberculosis (TB) Clearance: TB testing must be completed exclusively at an official International Organization for Migration (IOM) clinic in Islamabad, Lahore, Karachi, or Mirpur. TB certificates issued by non-approved private hospitals or labs will result in immediate visa refusal.
2. Validity Period: The IOM TB medical certificate is valid for 6 months from the date of the chest X-ray and must be valid on the date of your biometrics appointment.
3. Approved SELT Test Providers: Tests must be taken as 'IELTS for UKVI' (British Council / AEO), 'Pearson PTE Academic UKVI', or 'PSI Skills for English UKVI'. Standard academic or general tests without the official UKVI URN reference number are strictly unacceptable.
